howItWorks.title: Get started in three steps.

steps.title: Choose what to block
steps.body: Bundle the apps and sites that quietly steal your focus (social, video, news, games) into reusable blocklists you can launch in a single tap.

steps.title: Set it and lock in
steps.body: Pick a duration, hit start, and the nuclear lock seals the session shut. No pausing, no quitting, no bargaining your way out until the timer hits zero.

steps.title: Select your devices
steps.body: Connect your Mac, iPhone and iPad once, and every block stays in sync across all of them in real time. Your distractions run out of places to hide.

items.question: How does Welockin actually work?
items.answer: Three steps: pick the apps and sites you want gone, choose how strict the lock should be, hit start. Under a minute from install to locked in, on every synced device at once.

items.question: Is it really impossible to bypass?
items.answer: With a Nuclear lock: yes. It survives restarts and even uninstalling the app. Nothing turns it off before the timer or date you set.

items.question: Which apps and sites can I block?
items.answer: All of them. Apps, websites and notifications: you decide what gets through and what goes quiet.

items.question: Is it available on mobile?
items.answer: iOS, macOS and Windows are here today. Android is coming soon.

items.question: Are you really students?
